games.pronounsDescription: Learn who performs the action: I, you, he… and write the translation.
games.pronounsNote: 12 questions per round. Context distinguishes singular, plural and gender when a word has several translations. Covers personal and polite forms; excludes neuter or impersonal uses such as “it”. Spanish regional forms “vos” and “ustedes” are accepted in the appropriate contexts.

games.noGames: You have not played this game yet.
games.legacyScore: Your previous global score is kept separately: it cannot be split between games because it did not record which game each answer belonged to.
games.matchingDescription: Match each sentence with its translation. Practise with random verbs and people.
games.matchingPrompt: Select a sentence and then its translation.
games.matchingRules: 8 pairs per round. Earn 10 points for a first-try match; after a mistake, that pair earns 0. You can keep trying. Verbs and sentences vary randomly.
games.matchingError: These sentences do not match. Try another translation.
